title: Pages for the people in a film, and finding titles by them
description: A viewer would open a page for an actor or director and see their titles in the collection. PRODUCT.md doesn't promise it. The people in a title, with their photos, are planned on its details (JS-330, JS-331); more like this and genre filters from #107 are planned (JS-327).
